body.p: Why a cuckoo leaves its children. There lived a woman. This woman had three children. One day she got ill. Her children were playing outside. She wanted to drink some water. She called her elder son: "Son, bring me water, I am thirsty." The son said:"Go yourself." She called the second son, then the youngest â no one brought the mother water. She felt bad, so she thought, her children do not need her. She took her scraper board, she took her thimble, she used the scraper board as her wings, she used the thimble as her nose. She became a cuckoo, she said: "Cuckoo", â she flew away through the flue. Since then, the cuckoos do not need children, they throw them into other nests.
